```359:367:miataru/views/iPhone/Devices Views/iPhone_DeviceHistoryMapView.swift
    private func isSelectedEntry(_ entry: MiataruLocationData) -> Bool {
        guard let selectedTimelineEntry else { return false }
        return selectedTimelineEntry.Timestamp == entry.Timestamp &&
            selectedTimelineEntry.Latitude == entry.Latitude &&
            selectedTimelineEntry.Longitude == entry.Longitude
    }

        scrubTimestamp = entry.TimestampDate.timeIntervalSince1970
```

Playback now loops within the selected range: when it reaches the end, it automatically restarts from the start of the current selection. The loop respects play/pause and cancellation, keeps the “stepping” flag in sync, and still focuses the map on the surrounding entries.

```430:459:miataru/views/iPhone/Devices Views/iPhone_DeviceHistoryMapView.swift

                }
                currentStartIndex = 0
            }
            await MainActor.run {
```
